contract.definition: selectedCashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstances()->any(cashDesk: CashDesk | cashDesk.Id = cashDeskID)
contract.precondition: self.CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentStore.IsOpened = true and CashDesk.allInstances()->exists(cashDesk: CashDesk | cashDesk.Id = cashDeskID and cashDesk.IsOpened = false)
contract.postcondition: selectedCashDesk.IsOpened = true and self.CurrentCashDesk = selectedCashDesk and result = true
